title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Judges 21: Israel grieves for Benjamin and finds wives for the survivors from Jabesh Gilead and Shiloh.

questions.text: What had the men of Israel sworn in Mizpah?
questions.explanation: They had sworn, "None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife."

answers.text: None of them would ever fight Benjamin again
They would not go home until Gibeah was rebuilt
They would choose a king from Benjamin
None of them would give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife

questions.text: At Bethel, why did the people weep and question Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They asked why it had happened in Israel that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel that day.

answers.text: They had lost the first battle
One tribe was lacking in Israel
No rain had fallen for a year
The ark had been taken away

questions.text: What did the people do on the next day at Bethel?
questions.explanation: On the next day they rose early, built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

answers.text: They chose a king for Israel
They tore down the walls of Gibeah
They built an altar and offered sacrifices
They divided the land of Benjamin

questions.text: From which place had no one come to the assembly at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: No one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly; when the people were counted, none of its inhabitants were there.

questions.text: How many of the most valiant men did the congregation send against Jabesh Gilead?
questions.explanation: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there.

questions.text: How many young virgins were found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead?
questions.explanation: They found four hundred young virgins among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead and brought them to the camp at Shiloh.

questions.text: What did the congregation proclaim to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon?
questions.explanation: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

questions.text: Where was the yearly feast of Yahweh held, according to the elders?
questions.explanation: They said there was a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel.

questions.text: Where were the Benjamites told to lie in wait for the daughters of Shiloh?
questions.explanation: They commanded the children of Benjamin, "Go and lie in wait in the vineyards."

answers.text: In the caves of the hills

questions.text: What does the last verse of Judges 21 say about those days?
questions.explanation: The last verse says, "In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes."

answers.text: The land had rest for forty years
Everyone did what was right in his own eyes
Israel asked Samuel for a king
Benjamin was blotted out from Israel
